local.storage: HEARD-owned PostgreSQL (heard_cases, heard_case_events) inside RLS-scoped transactions

remote.blocker: Upstream Secure Intake & Case Workflow Engine API, version, token audience and event-signing contract have not been verified against a real deployment.

invariants: Never expose raw evidence in public API or index
Case events carry only allowlisted non-narrative metadata
State transitions are compare-and-set; replays and concurrent transitions fail with ADAPTER_STATE_CONFLICT
Missing and unauthorized cases are indistinguishable (ADAPTER_NOT_FOUND)
Credentials and service endpoints are configured server-side only
No public publication, partner export or replication by default
Remote mode never silently falls back to the local adapter
